title: Recommendation
description: A policy's answer to one request (#678 §4.3). A consumer drops it unless its identity matches the current request (ADR-008 §4).

choice.description: One choice from the request's LegalChoiceSet, in canonical engine syntax.

source_policy_id.description: The policy that produced the choice; the fallback's ID when it fell back.

elapsed_ms.description: From receipt of the request to the choice being ready.

deadline_outcome.description: How the submitted choice came about (#678 §3).

RequestIdentity.description: Which request a decision answers (ADR-004 r2, ADR-008 §4). A consumer drops a recommendation unless request_seq and request_hash both match, and rqid too when both carry one.

request_seq.description: Areneon's 1-based count of the requests one player has received in this battle, including wait requests.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request JSON without rqid (ADR-004 r2): lowercase hex.

rqid.description: The Showdown server's request id; present only on the server path (A2, the advisor), never hashed.
